name: tia_get_plc_tag_info
description: Read the supported metadata for one PLC tag, selected by exact name and tag-table scope.

table_name.description: Exact PLC tag-table name containing the tag.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact tag-table-group path, required when the table name is duplicated. Use an empty string for the root group.
